essence: Play-eager pair make-unmake varied worlds simultaneously, everywhere.

sections.SUMMARY: At play together, they make and unmake worlds in a single stroke.

rasa.sthayibhava: ullāsa (exuberant joy) at making-unmaking at once
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exuberant joy: play-eager, co-occurrent worlds. Play relished.
